name: Boltslinger lets a level-16 character's actual Darkslayer rank be cast while moving (#4762)
contract: Boltslinger 92091 ('Level 10 Passive') reads 'You may now cast Darkslayer while moving.' AscensionWitchHunterDefenses.cpp casts helper 500570 while 92091 is applied; 500570 is SPELL_AURA_313 (SpellFamilyName 21, EffectSpellClassMask word2=32), which Unit::CanCastSpellWhileMoving consults through HasAuraTypeWithAffectMask before refusing a moving cast with SPELL_FAILED_MOVING. The only Darkslayer a Witch Hunter can ever hold comes from AscensionCustomClassData.h's class-15 starting grant {15, 1, 804179} and AscensionSpellProgressionData.h's rank chain keyed on FirstSpellId 804179 (680256@6, 680257@14, 680258@22, ... 681203@60): a level-16 character sits on rank 680257 (required level 14, next rank 22). Every id in that chain, including 804179 itself, carries SpellFamilyFlags word2=32 (confirmed in Spell.dbc), an exact match for 500570's mask, and InterruptFlags 3 (movement + pushback) with a real cast time (CastingTimeIndex 19 = 2500 ms for 680257), so the moving-cast refusal and Boltslinger's exemption are both live for it. Spell ids 524715 and 800164 are also named 'Darkslayer' in Spell.dbc, but neither appears in any CoA class-spell grant, live baseline or progression table (grep across src/server/coa/ and data/sql), and 524715 additionally carries SpellLevel/BaseLevel 0 and EquippedItemClass -1 (no weapon requirement, unlike every real rank) - they are unreferenced, unobtainable DBC rows, not spells any Witch Hunter, at level 16 or otherwise, is ever granted. The classmask therefore already covers the one Darkslayer a level-16 character can actually cast.
